81tommy_inline void tommy_arrayof_grow(tommy_arrayof* array, tommy_size_t size)
82{
83 if (size > array->count) {
84 array->count = size;
85
86 if (size > array->bucket_max)
87 tommy_arrayof_reserve(array, size);
88 }
89}

126tommy_inline void* tommy_arrayof_ref(tommy_arrayof* array, tommy_size_t pos)
127{
128 assert(pos < array->count);
129
130 /* get the highest bit set, in case of all 0, return 0 */
131 tommy_uint_t bsr = tommy_ilog2(pos | 1);
132
133 unsigned char* ptr = tommy_cast(unsigned char*, array->bucket[bsr]);
134
135 return ptr + pos * array->element_size;
136}

144tommy_inline void* tommy_arrayof_tail(tommy_arrayof* array)
145{
146 assert(array->count != 0);
147 return tommy_arrayof_ref(array, array->count - 1);
148}
149
155tommy_inline void* tommy_arrayof_insert_tail(tommy_arrayof* array)
156{
157 tommy_size_t pos = array->count;
158
159 ++array->count;
160 if (array->count > array->bucket_max)
161 tommy_arrayof_reserve(array, array->count);
162
163 return tommy_arrayof_ref(array, pos);
164}
165
171tommy_inline void tommy_arrayof_remove_tail(tommy_arrayof* array)
172{
173 assert(array->count != 0);
174
175 tommy_size_t pos = array->count - 1;
176 void* ptr = tommy_arrayof_ref(array, pos);
177
178 /* keep unused slots zero so growing within capacity needs no initialization */
179 memset(ptr, 0, array->element_size);
180 array->count = pos;
181}
